overview.en: Troglodiplura lowryi is a cave-dwelling mygalomorph spider endemic to the Nullarbor Plain of southern Australia.
overview.fr: Troglodiplura lowryi est une mygale cavernicole endémique de la plaine de Nullarbor, dans le sud de l’Australie.

identification.en: It is an unusually cave-adapted spider, but its original taxonomic study was hampered by fragmentary or juvenile museum material.
identification.fr: C’est une araignée fortement adaptée à la vie cavernicole, mais son étude taxonomique initiale a été compliquée par des spécimens de musée fragmentaires ou juvéniles.

habitat.en: Known records place it in caves on the Nullarbor Plain.
habitat.fr: Les observations connues la situent dans des grottes de la plaine de Nullarbor.

diet.en: Reliable species-specific information about its prey was not available in the sources consulted.
diet.fr: Les sources consultées ne fournissent pas d’information fiable propre à l’espèce sur ses proies.

behavior.en: Its cave ecology remains poorly known, in part because adult specimens have been scarce in collections.
behavior.fr: Son écologie cavernicole reste mal connue, notamment parce que les collections comportent peu de spécimens adultes.

reproduction.en: The sources consulted do not describe its courtship, egg-laying or development.
reproduction.fr: Les sources consultées ne décrivent ni sa parade, ni sa ponte, ni son développement.

ecology.en: It is one of the most strongly cave-adapted mygalomorph spiders known.
ecology.fr: C’est l’une des mygales les plus spécialisées pour la vie souterraine parmi celles connues.

conservation.en: An Australian government draft assessment proposed classifying it as data deficient for federal threatened-species listing; that was a consultation proposal, not a final status in the cited source.
conservation.fr: Un projet d’évaluation du gouvernement australien proposait de la considérer comme « données insuffisantes » pour la liste fédérale des espèces menacées ; la source citée présente une consultation, pas un statut final.

title.en: Systematics and phylogenetic position of Troglodiplura
title.fr: Systématique et position phylogénétique de Troglodiplura

facts: The 2020 peer-reviewed revision describes T. lowryi as cave-endemic on the Nullarbor Plain, highly troglomorphic, and difficult to classify because available museum material was fragmentary, degraded or juvenile.

title.en: Australian Antarctic Data Centre — Taxon Profile: Troglodiplura lowryi
title.fr: Australian Antarctic Data Centre — fiche taxonomique : Troglodiplura lowryi

facts: The taxon profile provides nomenclatural and distribution metadata but no species-specific diet or reproductive account; these details remain undocumented in the consulted sources.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: The draft Australian assessment is explicitly a consultation proposal and must not be presented as a completed statutory listing decision.
Diet and reproduction are stated as unreported in consulted sources, not as biologically absent.
review_note: The 2020 revision added congeners, so no outdated claim that T. lowryi is the sole species of Troglodiplura is made.
